name: Custom Shape Wooden Tracker Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, ensuring durability and a warm, rustic appearance.
    - Features a multi-layer wooden structure, all layers made from 3mm thick wood.
    - Smooth laser-cut edges provide a clean finish and comfortable handling.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple designs and sizes:
                     +) 6 x 7 inches ~ 15.24 x 17.78 cm.
                     +) 7 x 8 inches ~ 17.78 x 20.32 cm.
                     +) 8 x 9 inches ~ 20.32 x 22.86 cm.
    - Number cards: Wooden 3mm, minimum size 2 cm.
    - Custom decorative pieces: Wooden 3mm, minimum size 2 cm.
    - Box walls are also made from 3mm wooden panels.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using high-quality printing technology for clear details and vibrant colors.
    - Double-sided printing applied to box wall, layer 1, number cards, and custom pieces for a polished look.
    - Single-sided printing applied to layer 2 and layer 3.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a multi-purpose tracking display to record meaningful numbers and milestones.
    - Can be used to track books read, anniversary days, days together, workout sessions, goals achieved, and more.
    - Includes interchangeable number cards for easy updates anytime.
    - Suitable for display on desks, shelves, offices, classrooms, or personal spaces.
    -.Functions as both a motivational tracker and a decorative keepsake.
    📌 Note: Customers can easily assemble the product by slotting the pre-cut wooden pieces together step by step. No tools or glue required.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful and versatile gift for partners, friends, family members, students, teachers, and colleagues.
    - Suitable for birthdays, anniversaries, graduations, holidays, Valentine’s Day, housewarmings, and special milestones.
    - A unique keepsake that celebrates memories, achievements, and important moments.

    SPECIFICATION
  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape Wooden Tracker Sign

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
